title: The Draper's Wife and the Deceitful Crone
summary: In Damascus lived an honest linen-draper and his virtuous, intelligent wife, Fatima. A malicious old woman, hired by an envious competitor to disrupt their domestic peace, visit...
keywords: story of the crone and the draper's wife
full_text:
In Damascus lived an honest linen-draper and his virtuous, intelligent wife, Fatima. A malicious old woman, hired by an envious competitor to disrupt their domestic peace, visited Fatima’s house, weeping and claiming that her husband was secretly purchasing costly silks for a rival household in the next quarter.

Fatima listened with calm, piercing eyes. Rather than flying into a jealous rage, she noticed that the old woman’s story had multiple contradictions regarding dates and names.

Fatima smiled cheerfully: 'O mother, thank you for your sisterly concern! Come with me into the cellar, where I keep thirty jars of delicious pickled lemons; I will give you a large jar to sweeten your kindness!'

She led the gossiping crone down the stone stairs into the cool cellar, walked out, and slammed the heavy oak door, locking it with two iron bolts!

Fatima then went directly to the bazaar, brought her husband and the village magistrate to the house, and opened the cellar door in their presence.

Before the law, the terrified old woman confessed that she had been paid ten dirhams by a rival merchant to invent the slanderous lie!

The magistrate punished the slanderer and fined the competitor, while the draper embraced his wise wife, thanking heaven for a companion whose intellect was a shield against all the venom of malicious gossip.
moral: A clear mind and moral vigilance dismantle the most insidious schemes of gossip and deceit.
